manifest.name: analytics
manifest.title: Product analytics
manifest.description: Capturer port with a PostHog adapter and a no-op default so every call site can fire and forget.

manifest.name: apphost
manifest.title: Application host seam
manifest.description: Leaf ambient-environment seam (configuration lookup, logging, clock, version) that every runtime module is constructed against.

manifest.name: billing
manifest.title: Billing
manifest.description: Plan truth, entitlement checks, the provider client port, and subscription webhook state machine.

environment.description: Polar product id for the pro plan
Polar product id for the team plan

manifest.name: config
manifest.title: Configuration
manifest.description: Environment parsing and validation. Reads through the host seam so a runtime can boot against a fixed environment.

environment.description: Synthetic e2e sessions; refused in production
Shed all traffic except probes and static
Bearer gate for /metrics; required in production
Freezes the render clock under APP_ENV=test

manifest.name: database
manifest.title: Database
manifest.description: The Postgres connection pool, the embedded migration runner, and the generated query layer's configuration. Owns the pool lifecycle: opening, migrating, and closing.

manifest.name: identity
manifest.title: Identity
manifest.description: Authentication ports (verifier, user fetcher, deleter), request context keys, and provider account sync.

environment.description: Clerk Frontend API origin; feeds CSP connect-src

manifest.name: llm
manifest.title: Language model
manifest.description: Completer port backed by any OpenAI-compatible API. Unconfigured leaves the port nil so AI routes answer 503.

manifest.name: mail
manifest.title: Transactional mail
manifest.description: Sender port with a Resend adapter and a development sender that writes to disk.

environment.description: Resend API key; unset uses the dev sender

manifest.name: modkit
manifest.title: Module registry engine
manifest.description: The registry engine and the ggg command line: catalog loading, dependency resolution, conflict-aware sync, pristine-only removal, transactional apply, and deterministic generation.

manifest.name: observability
manifest.title: Error reporting
manifest.description: Reporter port with a Sentry adapter and a no-op default so call sites never nil-check.

environment.description: Sentry DSN; unset uses the no-op reporter

manifest.name: storage
manifest.title: Object storage
manifest.description: Store port with an R2/S3-compatible adapter and a development store rooted in tmp/uploads.

manifest.name: testdb
manifest.title: Per-package test databases
manifest.description: Gives every integration-test package its own database so parallel packages cannot nuke each other's fixtures. Skips when no server is reachable.
